Goal: I can prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram on the coordinate plane using slopes and midpoints.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
On the coordinate plane we can prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram by computing.

Method 1: show both pairs of opposite sides have equal slopes, so they are parallel. Method 2: show the diagonals have the same midpoint, so they bisect each other.

Example: A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(6, 5), D(2, 4). Slope AB = 1/4 = slope DC, and slope BC = 4/2 = 2 = slope AD. Also both diagonals have midpoint (3, 2.5). So ABCD is a parallelogram.
